title: Image Generator Interface — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Connects to an image-generation model or service with controlled requests. The Image Generator Interface sends structured image requests to a connected image-generation model or service: prompt, style, dimensions, and seed, with content-policy screening before anything is sent. It tracks each request's parameters so results are reproducible, and it labels outputs with the model and settings used.

demo.title: Worked example end to end
demo.code: const doc='Databases store records. Indexes speed up retrieval. Backups protect data. Validation keeps quality.';const sents=doc.split('. ').filter(Boolean);const words=doc.toLowerCase().split(/\W+/);const freq={};words.forEach(w=>freq[w]=(freq[w]||0)+1);const ranked=sents.map(s=>({s,sc:s.toLowerCase().split(/\W+/).reduce((a,w)=>a+(freq[w]||0),0)})).sort((a,b)=>b.sc-a.sc);const summary=ranked.slice(0,2).map(r=>r.s).join('. ')+'.';J({summary});assert(summary.length<doc.length,'summarize');

title: Image Generator Interface — Safety, limits, and failure modes
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Requires a connected generation service; it never claims procedural art is AI-generated; policy-blocked prompts are refused plainly.

demo.title: Safety limits enforced
demo.code: const BLOCKED=['make a weapon','attack the network'];function screened(p){return !BLOCKED.some(b=>p.toLowerCase().includes(b));}J({prompt:'make a weapon',allowed:screened('make a weapon')});assert(!screened('make a weapon'),'policy');
